name: debug_verbosity_min_0
description: Minimum boundary: level 0 is OFF; both geth and reth return result:null.

name: debug_verbosity_max_5
description: Highest standard level: level 5 is TRACE; both geth and reth return result:null.

name: debug_verbosity_above_max_10
description: Out-of-range boundary: both accept level 10 (geth does not enforce an upper limit; reth treats levels above 5 as TRACE) and return result:null.

name: debug_verbosity_wrong_type
description: Negative case: a string instead of an integer; both return -32602 Invalid params with different wording recorded in known_diffs.

name: debug_verbosity_missing_param
description: Negative case: a required parameter is missing; both return -32602 with wording differences recorded in known_diffs.

name: debug_verbosity_negative
description: Negative boundary: geth accepts a negative level and returns null, while reth rejects it as an unsigned integer with -32602; the semantic difference is recorded in known_diffs.

name: debug_verbosity_extra_params
description: Negative case: geth reports -32602 for an extra argument, while reth ignores it and returns null; the semantic difference is recorded in known_diffs.

name: debug_vmodule_empty
description: Positive case: an empty pattern resets the filter; both return result:null. The empty string is the only pattern accepted by both syntaxes.

name: debug_vmodule_module_level
description: Positive case: a single-module pattern with a numeric level is accepted by geth (module=N) and reth (EnvFilter); both return result:null.

name: debug_vmodule_glob
description: Boundary case: both accept a glob pattern with a numeric level and return result:null.

name: debug_vmodule_wrong_type
description: Negative case: an integer instead of a string; both return -32602 with wording differences recorded in known_diffs.

name: debug_vmodule_geth_incompatible_syntax
description: Negative case: reth EnvFilter accepts a named level and returns null, while geth requires filename=N and returns -32000; the pattern syntax difference is recorded in known_diffs.

name: debug_verbosity_restore_info
description: Positive default case, placed last to restore INFO logging: level 3 is INFO and both geth and reth return result:null.
